question: Which revolutionary leader attempted to assassinate Lord Hardinge?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rash Behari Bose**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rash Behari Bose**, a prominent revolutionary leader, was involved in the attempt to assassinate **Lord Hardinge** in **Delhi** during the ceremonial procession of transferring the capital from Calcutta to Delhi in **1912**.
 
• The assassination attempt was carried out using a bomb, which was thrown at the elephant carrying Lord Hardinge. Though Lord Hardinge was injured, he survived the attack.
 
• The attack was orchestrated by Rash Behari Bose, who played a significant role in revolutionary activities against the British rule in India. *Hence, the correct option is Rash Behari Bose.*
 
• Rash Behari Bose was closely associated with other revolutionary leaders and was instrumental in organizing several anti-British movements, including the **Ghadar Movement** and later the formation of the **Indian National Army**.
 
• The attempt to assassinate Lord Hardinge was a bold act that showcased the growing resistance against British rule during the early 20th century. *Hence, Rash Behari Bose's involvement in revolutionary activities is well documented.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Rash Behari Bose:**

 
 
• **Born:** Rash Behari Bose was born on **25th May 1886** in **West Bengal**.
 
• He was a key figure in revolutionary activities in India and later in Japan, where he worked to garner support for Indian independence.
 
• **Contribution:** He was involved in the **Delhi Conspiracy Case** (assassination attempt on Lord Hardinge) and played a pivotal role in the **Ghadar Movement**.
 
 
 
• **Lord Hardinge:**
 
 
• **Designation:** Lord Hardinge served as the **Viceroy of India** from **1910 to 1916**.
 
• During his tenure, the capital of India was shifted from **Calcutta** to **Delhi** in **1912**.
 
 
 
• **Revolutionary Activities in India:**
 
 
• The early 20th century saw the rise of revolutionary movements in India aimed at overthrowing British rule.
 
• **Key Figures:** Leaders like **Rash Behari Bose**, **Chandra Shekhar Azad**, **Bhagat Singh**, and **Khudiram Bose** were involved in various revolutionary activities.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Delhi Conspiracy Case:**

 
 
• The case involved the attempt to assassinate Lord Hardinge in **Delhi** during the transfer of the capital.
 
• Though the attempt failed, it highlighted the growing discontent against British rule.
 
 
 
• **Legacy of Rash Behari Bose:**
 
 
• Rash Behari Bose later moved to **Japan**, where he continued to work for Indian independence and laid the foundation for the **Indian National Army**.
 
• He is remembered as a visionary leader who inspired many to join the freedom struggle.
